trigger: Surface-enabled raw vertical acceleration standard deviation 11.7955 m/s^2 versus 2.85e-11 m/s^2 with Surface disabled.
scope: VRX linear acceleration only; angular rate and orientation are not filtered.
placement: After quaternion-based gravity compensation and FLU-to-body-NED conversion, before the 15-field observation conditioner.

design.type: causal fourth-order critically damped low-pass implemented as four identical one-pole sections
design.duplicate_timestamp_rule: Return cached output without advancing filter state

rationale: The Surface impulse sequence contains large near-Nyquist components at the 20 Hz physics/sample rate. Four 1 Hz poles strongly attenuate those impulses while preserving the common task's slow vessel acceleration envelope.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: Do not change order, cutoff, initialization, or placement after viewing the filtered equivalence result without creating a new explicitly reviewed protocol.
